subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- November 17, 2026
body:
Calamares init failure fix prevents installer crashes on fresh ISOs

Development
A critical bug in the Calamares installer was fixed today by cobra3282000. The issue, a faulty sequence entry in shellprocess2, could cause the installer to fail during initialization on fresh AcreetionOS ISOs. This is a significant fix for anyone attempting a new installation, as it ensures the setup process starts smoothly. The change has been committed to cobra3228000/calamares-config and will be included in the next build. You can track this and other fixes on the changelog.

Community
The community continues to make small but important improvements to the CI pipeline. Recent commits show work on release automation and workflow validation, ensuring that new versions of AcreetionOS are published reliably. Meanwhile, the project's presence on GitLab remains active, with both Natalie and Darren maintaining their repositories for various components, from Wayland configs to Firefox fixes. The homepage remains the best place to see the full scope of what's happening.

Tip of the day
If you're customizing your AcreetionOS installation, the Calamares configuration modules are your friend. The detailed documentation on configuring the installer is available in the docs section. It explains how to add or modify modules, which is useful for tailoring the setup process to your specific needs, especially if you're creating custom ISOs or helping others install the distro.
